settings.heading: Filtered Shower Head
settings.text: A multi-stage filtered shower head that helps remove chlorine and harsh stuff from tap water — science-backed purity for your family.

settings.question: How often do I need to replace the filter?
settings.answer: Dr. Droppy’s rule: swap the cartridge every 90 days.

settings.question: Will pressure drop?
settings.answer: It’s engineered for high flow with filtration.

settings.question: How does Autoship work?
settings.answer: Choose Autoship to add the showerhead plus Carbon Filters on a Loop plan. Filters ship every 90 days. Pause, skip, or cancel anytime in the Loop portal.

settings.heading: Ready for cleaner showers?
settings.text: Choose Autoship or one-time — Dr. Droppy will take it from there.
